description: This file defines classes and interfaces for terrain and brush palette widgets used in the map editor of the Wesnoth game, including terrain selection and brush size controls.

classes.name: terrain_palette
classes.description: A widget for selecting terrain types in the map editor, supporting scrolling and terrain selection.

classes.name: brush_bar
classes.description: A widget for selecting brush sizes in the map editor.

methods.name: scroll_up
methods.description: Scrolls the terrain palette up by one step.

methods.name: scroll_down
methods.description: Scrolls the terrain palette down by one step.

methods.name: scroll_top
methods.description: Scrolls the terrain palette to the top.

methods.name: scroll_bottom
methods.description: Scrolls the terrain palette to the bottom.

methods.name: selected_fg_terrain
methods.description: Returns the currently selected foreground terrain.

methods.name: selected_bg_terrain
methods.description: Returns the currently selected background terrain.

methods.name: select_fg_terrain
methods.description: Selects a foreground terrain.

methods.name: select_bg_terrain
methods.description: Selects a background terrain.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Draws the terrain palette; can force redraw.

methods.name: handle_event
methods.description: Handles SDL events for terrain palette interactions.

methods.name: set_dirty
methods.description: Marks the widget as needing redraw.

methods.name: num_terrains
methods.description: Returns the number of terrains in the palette.

methods.name: adjust_size
methods.description: Adjusts the widget size based on size specifications.

methods.name: draw_old
methods.description: Internal method for drawing old palette style.

methods.name: left_mouse_click
methods.description: Handles left mouse click events for terrain selection.

methods.name: right_mouse_click
methods.description: Handles right mouse click events.

methods.name: tile_selected
methods.description: Returns the tile index at given coordinates.

methods.name: get_terrain_string
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a terrain.

methods.name: update_report
methods.description: Updates the report with current terrain selections.

methods.name: selected_brush_size
methods.description: Returns the currently selected brush size.

methods.name: select_brush_size
methods.description: Selects a new brush size.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Draws the brush bar; can force redraw.

methods.name: handle_event
methods.description: Handles SDL events for brush bar interactions.

methods.name: adjust_size
methods.description: Adjusts the brush bar size based on size specifications.

methods.name: left_mouse_click
methods.description: Handles mouse click events for brush selection.

methods.name: selected_index
methods.description: Returns the index of the selected brush at given coordinates.
